infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: We use your location to surface nearby technicians and live ETA updates while a job is in progress.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Take photos of the appliance so the technician can come prepared with the right parts.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Attach photos of the appliance so the technician can come prepared.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Record short voice notes describing the issue for the technician.
